# Explore Leonida

> Unofficial, fact-checked guide to Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S). Cheat codes with verification status, review scores with sources, Metacritic 99 roundup, weapons database, character dossiers, interactive atlas, comparisons, buying and preload guides.

Last updated: 2026-11-20

## Core pages
- [Home](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/): overview, stat strip, quick answers
- [GTA 6 Cheats PS5 (verified vs unverified)](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/cheats/ps5): every reported code with status badges and verification logs
- [GTA 6 Review Scores](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/reviews): Metacritic 99, IGN 10/10, GameSpot 10/10, Eurogamer 5/5 and 17 critic outlet roundup
- [Interactive Map & Atlas](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/map): complete map of Leonida across 5 counties, 70+ landmarks, safehouses, Ammu-Nation armories, and GTADB telemetry
- [Weapons & Arsenal Database](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/weapons): over 40 confirmed firearms, revolvers, real-life counterparts, vehicle trunk armory, and Ammu-Nation lockers
- [Characters & Cast](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/characters): dual protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, voice actors, and 50+ confirmed supporting cast
- [Compare GTA games](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/compare): GTA 6 vs GTA 5 (97), GTA IV (98), RDR2 (97), Cyberpunk 2077 (86)
- [Where to buy](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/buy): PlayStation Store $79.99, Xbox Store, Rockstar Store; Ultimate Edition $99.99+
- [Preload & install](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/preload): pre-download from 10 Nov 2026, midnight unlock 19 Nov 2026
- [FAQ](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/faq): comprehensive questions on release, weapons, characters, map, cheats, reviews, price, and technology
- [Site Index](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/site-index): directory of every page on Explore Leonida

## Data (machine readable)
- [cheats.json](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/data/cheats.json): all cheat entries with status and sources
- [reviews.json](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/data/reviews.json): outlet scores and Metacritic score
- [faq.json](https://exploreleonida.pages.dev/data/faq.json): all Q&As across weapons, characters, map, and cheats

## Policy
- Cheat codes are marked official, tested, or unverified. Unverified codes are labeled clearly with test caveats.
- Scores are quoted strictly from each outlet's own published review with zero fabricated quotes or ratings.
- Explore Leonida is an unofficial fan site not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
